description: An access list. Password hashes are never part of an answer

name.description: Name shown in the lists and when choosing an access list

satisfy_any.description: Whether a visitor needs to pass only one of the checks (a basic auth user or an allowed address) instead of all

pass_auth.description: Whether the basic auth credentials are passed on to the upstream server

proxy_host_count.description: Number of proxy hosts that use the list. Only the access list routes carry it; the access lists inside a proxy host do not

owner.description: The user who created it; only with `expand`

items.description: The basic auth users; only with `expand` (and in the answers of create, update, get and delete)

created_on.description: When the user was added, in UTC

modified_on.description: When the user was last saved, in UTC

access_list_id.description: ID of the access list the user belongs to

username.description: Name the user signs in with

clients.description: The address rules in the order nginx checks them; only with `expand` (and in the answers of create, update, get and delete)

created_on.description: When the rule was added, in UTC

modified_on.description: When the rule was last saved, in UTC

access_list_id.description: ID of the access list the rule belongs to

address.description: The client address or network the rule matches, or `all`

directive.description: Whether a matching address is allowed or denied

npmpro_comment.description: A note for the rule, shown with the rule (it is not written into the nginx config)

npmpro_geo_mode.description: The country rule: `off`, `allow` (only the listed countries pass) or `deny` (the listed countries are blocked)

npmpro_geo_unknown.description: What happens to an address with no country: `auto` (blocked in allow mode, passed in deny mode), `pass` or `block`

npmpro_geo_drop.description: Whether a request blocked by a country rule is dropped without an answer (nginx status 444) instead of the denied page

npmpro_countries.description: The countries of the country rule, sorted by code; only with `expand` (and in the answers of create, update, get and delete)
